ops-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING - hosted-api-us-east-1: sustained queue growth > 22k, p95 latency 6.8s p99 18.2s, error rate 3.2% (timeouts + 5xx). Autoscaler reported repeated failures. Pager: ryan (oncall)

ryan (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs. any customer-visible notices yet?

emily (support): seeing increased 504s reported from AcmeCorp and EduLabs. Support ticket numbers 4582, 4583. Customers are getting timeouts at scale.

maya (sre): Confirmed. queue depth per-host trending up, backpressure kicking in but not draining. Autoscaler tried 6 scale-up events in last 12m, nodes stuck in Provisioning -> Pending.

samir (infra): I see cloud API errors in the autoscaler controller: `403 QuotaExceeded: GPU cores` and intermittent `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` when the new nodes try to join. Two separate failure modes.

ryan (oncall): ack. Prioritize quota hit first. samir, can you check quota limits and whether there's any recent quota change?

samir (infra): Calling cloud provider support now. Quick check: account quota for nvidia-t4 is 120, current allocated 118, pending requested 24 -> exceeds hard quota. There's a reserved pool for Dedicated customers that we can't freely borrow without approval.

maya (sre): Meanwhile we need short-term mitigation to reduce customer impact. Ideas: 1) enable degraded routing to smaller model family (fast-small) 2) enable request-level rate-limiting for heavy keys 3) increase async retry TTL and surface to clients 4) enable prefix cache aggressively.

julie (product): For PLG customers, degraded model is fine; for enterprise SLAs (AcmeCorp) we need to coordinate. We should notify impacted customers before routing.

ryan (oncall): Do the degraded route now for non-enterprise traffic. samir, can we hot-patch routing rules?

samir (infra): Pushing patch to routing plane: `routeset apply --namespace=hosted --degrade=fast-small --match=plan!=enterprise` Applying...

ops-bot: ROUTE CHANGE applied by samir at 2361112380: degraded route active for non-enterprise.

ryan (oncall): Good. That should lower GPU demand ~40% for mixed workloads. Maya, flip prefix cache aggressive policy?

maya (sre): Doing `redwood-cachectl set --ttl=1800 --prefix-whitelist=/chat,/complete` to maximize reuse. TTL update pushed. Expect immediate token savings on repeated prompts.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: AcmeCorp (escalation), EduLabs (info). Draft message posted to #support-drafts for review.

emily (support): I'll send AcmeCorp a heads-up and offer dedicated channel. Do not change their routing yet (enterprise).

samir (infra): Cloud provider acknowledged; they've temporarily bumped GPU quota by +24 while they review our request. New nodes show `Provisioning` -> `Running` but some fail TLS join. Investigating join failures: looks like boot image rolled a cert rotation yesterday that our bootstrap doesn't accept if the node is older than 12h.

maya (sre): For nodes failing join with x509, we can set autoscaler to ignore failing nodes temporarily and re-route. But more robust is to force a new bootstrap image via instance metadata. samir can you push that?

samir (infra): Rolling a forced bootstrap image on the provisioning group now. Command: ```cloudctl instances update --group=hosted-us-east-provisioners --image=redwood-bootstrap-2026-03-15```. Applying...

ops-bot: AUTOSCALER log snippet (2361112450): ```E controller.go:274 scaleUp attempt failed: cloudapi: 403 QuotaExceeded```. Then at 2361112505: ```W nodejoin.go:112 x509: certificate signed by unknown authority```.

ryan (oncall): Timeline so far: initial spike started ~2361112200, autoscaler hit quota and then nodejoin cert failure around 2361112440. We've applied degraded routes (non-enterprise) and cache changes. Customer-critical (AcmeCorp) still on full route, showing timeouts.

julie (product): For AcmeCorp, immediate option: route their traffic to 'dedicated-preempt' pool (lower throughput but guaranteed nodes) or enable per-account soft rate-limit. Which is faster?

samir (infra): Routing to dedicated-preempt requires cordoning and moving nodes; takes ~6-8 minutes. Soft rate-limit config can be toggled in <1m with `rlctl`.

ryan (oncall): Do soft rate-limit for AcmeCorp for now (5% throttling) and offer a prioritized queue to minimize tail latency. emily, let them know we're doing a short throttle to stabilize; will follow up with EP.

emily (support): Message queued and sent. Customer acknowledged and prefers temporary throttling to repeated 504s.

maya (sre): Monitoring: queue depth decreasing 12% since degraded route/caching and new nodes coming up. p95 now 3.1s p99 9.0s. Error rate falling to 1.1%.

samir (infra): Bootstrap image push completed at 2361112720. New nodes joining healthy. Autoscaler resumed and created 10 new instances; allocation now within quota.

ops-bot: METRICS snapshot (2361112800): queue_depth_total 10.2k (down from 22k), p95 2.9s, p99 7.2s, 5xx 0.6%.

ryan (oncall): Good progress. Actions to close this incident: 1) keep degraded route for 15m buffer 2) roll permanent bootstrap fix to prevent cert drift 3) open ticket with cloud provider for quota expansion 4) postmortem and action items assigned.

julie (product): I'll prepare customer comms for AcmeCorp and EduLabs summarizing mitigation and ETA for full restoration.

samir (infra): I'll follow up with infra change: add proactive bootstrap image validation and automate forced-refresh for instances older than 6h. Also request quota increase through sales channel.

maya (sre): I'll attach the relevant dashboards, logs, and the `autoscaler` controller traces to the incident. Setting follow-up meeting in 30m for handoff.

ryan (oncall): Handoff: I'll be off in 25m; maya will take post-incident ownership. If anything regresses, page "sre-oncall". Otherwise transitioning to monitoring phase.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations active, customer throttles applied for enterprise, degraded route for non-enterprise, bootstrap patch rolled, cloud quota temporary bump accepted.

support-bot: Tickets updated: 4582 (AcmeCorp) -> customer notified and throttled; 4583 (EduLabs) -> degraded route applied; both set to priority P1 until resolved.

ryan (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving a brief incident note in #incidents with next steps. maya, samir, julie - please own the postmortem items.

maya (sre): On it. I'll collect logs and draft the timeline. Planned postmortem items: autoscaler resilience for mixed failure modes, quota monitoring alerts, bootstrap image rotation test, emergency routing runbook.

samir (infra): I'll add infra action items and open PR for bootstrap validation.

julie (product): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and SLA remediations.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigations in place) at 2361113200 :white_check_mark:
